purpose: Single synthetic live discussion after concise wording update; not a benchmark or a physical test

brief.input: recycled rubber pieces with a characterized binder stock
brief.targets: wet grip and durability matter; test methods and limits are not yet known

request.question:
Help me interpret this mix simulation for Synthetic mat setup, version 1 (ID synthetic-setup), and suggest the next actions and product checks.

Portion: 1 kg, with 26 mass percent recycled rubber. Added stock: characterized binder, with 0 mass percent recycled rubber. Chosen mix: 20 mass percent recycled rubber.

Estimated addition: approximately 0.3 kg. Example: approximately 0.3 kg gives approximately 20 mass percent recycled rubber. Figures are approximate and assume complete, loss-free mixing.

questions.question: What is this stock's amount and quantity basis? Unknown context can remain captured.
Which relevant specimen/product geometry or installation conditions describe it?
Which property checks are required for this product? No required checks cannot establish an all-check result.

warnings: This assessment describes entered readings only; no interpolation, causal effect, future-batch consistency or finished-product qualification is established.

response.answer:
The 0.3 kg figure checks out as arithmetic for that entered case only. From 1 kg at 26% rubber, adding 0.3 kg binder at 0% rubber gives 1.3 kg at 20% rubber if mixing is complete with no loss. This number does not show wet grip or durability.

Keep the earlier setup unchanged. Record the rubber amount with what it was weighed on, plus mat size and how it will sit indoors, then pick one wet-grip check and one durability check for that exact mat before preparing quantities.
next_steps: Confirm how the 1 kg and 26% were measured for this portion, since the stored setup still has blank amount
Record mat size, thickness and indoor installation for the test piece
Select the required wet-grip evaluation and durability check for that exact mat, including instrumented slip assessment by a trained operator under wet conditions
questions: How was the 26% rubber share measured for this 1 kg portion?
What size and thickness is the test mat and how will it lie indoors?
What counts as usable for wet grip and durability for this mat?

sources.title: HSE — assessing floor slip resistance
sources.scope: General floor-slip testing guidance, including instrumented pendulum assessment by a suitably trained operator under relevant surface conditions. It supplies no measured slip value, acceptance target or qualification for the user's recycled material, and no home walking test substitutes for it. Check the current applicable method for the product and installation.
